sensors.name: right light sensor RLIGHT (the light from above)
left light sensor LLIGHT (the light from above)
line tracker, as a brightness in %

control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT < 60: (if LLIGHT < 45: curve 15/35; elif line tracker > 95 %: curve 35/15; else: avoidWalls) else avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70: (if obstacle LEFT: turn right 20°; elif obstacle RIGHT: turn left 20°; else: driveInTheDark) else driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70: drive forward 30 %; else: stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if obstacle FRONT: stop; else: followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black: curve 10/40; else curve 40/10.

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow a black line when one is under the robot and drive straight when there is none; in the light, follow the line as before.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads below 60 % (the robot is deep enough in a tunnel)

branches.outcome: the right light is below 60 %: it goes into the dark handling
the right light is 60 % or more: it calls avoidWalls

decision_points.condition: first: the left light is below 45 %; second: the line tracker reads more than 95 %

branches.outcome: the left light is below 45 %: it curves left at 15/35
not that dark, the line tracker reads more than 95 %: it curves right at 35/15
not that dark, the line tracker reads 95 % or less: it calls avoidWalls
the left light is below 70 %: it checks the obstacle sensors
the left light is 70 % or more: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: first: an obstacle is seen on the LEFT; second: an obstacle is seen on the RIGHT

branches.outcome: an obstacle on the left: it turns right 20°
no obstacle on the left, one on the right: it turns left 20°
no obstacle on either side: it calls driveInTheDark
the left light is below 70 %: it drives forward at 30 %
the left light is 70 % or more: it calls stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is seen in FRONT

branches.outcome: an obstacle in front: it stops
nothing in front: it calls followLine
no black: it curves right at 40/10

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left at 10/40 on black and right at 40/10 otherwise; if an obstacle comes in front, it stops
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line, in bright light
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the white band, again and again
scenarios.title: In the light, follows the line
assumptions: You said to follow the line in the light; stopping at a wall in front is taken from your program, since you didn't say it.

scenarios.coded_response: In dim light it curves left at 15/35 when the left light is below 45 %, curves right at 35/15 on the bright band, and otherwise turns away from walls or drives straight at 30 %; in the darkest part it only curves left at 15/35
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in a tunnel, in dim light near the opening or in the darkest part, with a black line, the bright band, or the plain floor under the line tracker

scenarios.coded_response: It turns right 20° for a wall on the left and left 20° for a wall on the right, then drives on
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is in a tunnel in dim light, with a wall in front of its left half or its right half
scenarios.trigger: An obstacle sensor on the left or the right sees something less than 3 cm ahead
scenarios.title: In the dark, turns away from a wall beside it
assumptions: You didn't say it, but in the dark your program turns away from walls beside it, so it should get through a bend without bumping.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It turns away from the wall and gets on without bumping into it

uncertainties: Your dark handling only looks at the line tracker while the light is between 45 % and 60 %: deeper in a tunnel it curves left whatever is under the robot.
A line tracker reading above 95 % is the bright band beside a line, so your program only steers on that band, never on the black core.
You didn't say how dark counts as dark: your program uses the right light below 60 % for that, and the left light below 45 % for the darkest case.
'As before' in your sentence refers to nothing you said earlier: I take it as the line following your program does in the light.
The dim band where your program reads the line tracker is only about 10 to 14 cm inside a tunnel; from 15 cm inside the light is 40 %.
